text: The paper reports that over 5% of summaries from the best 175B model received 6/7 and over 15% received 5/7 on a Likert scale, scores sometimes also given to human-written summaries. On average, model summaries were still significantly worse than human-written ones.
title: Full-book summaries: some approach human-level quality, but on average still significantly worse than human
